Path: business objects, records and views | none (no checklist item asserts these types) | none

## Triage: first grade — `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded) — direction: retire, on the ruling objectui#7659 already carries

Triage: lands in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` (the "Phase 3.5" banner and the eight declarations, `:664`–`:887` on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`) and `packages/types/src/index.ts:607`–`:614` (the root export). These are the contract face of `@object-ui/types` ⇒ `domain:spec`, as other objectui cards whose only landing site is `packages/types` are routed. Rationale: `AdvancedValidationSchema` and its seven siblings typed `ValidationEngine`, which PR objectui#10709 retired. Re-measured on `origin/main` `f9c06ef`: every hit for the eight names is in those two files, `ValidationContext` and `ValidationFunction` have no reader outside `packages/types`, and the lit control `FieldValidationRules` answers. This is a declared surface with no reader, so it goes to enforce-or-remove, not to the three finding classes.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:39Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), both files on objectui `origin/main`, the whole thread of objectui#7659, and PR objectui#10709's ACCEPT `5839362757`.

**Why this is queued, not sent to the decision box.**
- `Prior rulings on this card:` objectstack-ai/objectui#7659 `5548579814` (maintainer, decision batch #40 item 4, 「同意」 to option A). It retired the `ValidationEngine` vocabulary from `@object-ui/core` under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, because that vocabulary had zero consumers while `buildValidationRules` does the job.
- These eight names are the same vocabulary's type half, and the same reason holds for them, measured today: zero consumers in objectui and in objectstack. Out-of-repo consumers are unmeasured, exactly as they were for ruling A.
- `Governing text:` the rule that a new branch of a ruled family reuses the parent's ruling, with its reason, and goes straight to the queue. A real semantic difference would reopen it, and none is measured. Also North Star 阶段姿态: 声明了但不兑现的键按发布批量退役,不一键一卡 (declared keys that nothing enforces retire in release batches, not one card per key). That is why the eight names go as one change.
- PR objectui#10709 kept these types only as scope discipline (its dev report: 「a separate Clause-2 public-type removal」). That is not a ruling to keep them.
- **If the claiming seat measures a live reader** (in-repo, or a named out-of-repo consumer), stop and report it here, and the card goes to the decision box then.

**Execution notes.**
1. The eight names leave `data-protocol.ts` and the root export, and the "Phase 3.5 … Complete Validation Engine" banner and docblocks go with them. `Clause-②: yes` (a public type removal): a `minor` changeset with a BREAKING banner, per objectui convention.
2. The pending changesets that name them get a dated note: `9909-machine-locale-sweep` (`ValidationContext.locale`), `7659-retire-validation-engine` (「keep their shapes」), `6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-2` (`ValidationFunction`) and `7357-retire-field-metadata-depends-on` (`AdvancedValidationRule.depends_on`). `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx:121`–`:124` drops the two near-spellings it lists.
3. A barrel-absence pin, runtime and compile-time, in the objectui#7659 shape.
4. ⛔ Not this card: `FieldValidationRules`, `FieldValidationFunction`, `ObjectValidationRule` and `DesignerValidationRule` are live or separate. Anchor on the eight qualified names, never on bare `validate` / `validation`.

**Serial constraints.** Open PR objectui#10710 also edits `packages/types/src/index.ts`, in a different region. Rebase if it lands first.

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for `AdvancedValidation|ValidationRuleType|Complete Validation Engine` ⇒ only PR objectui#10709. No duplicate.

Claim: PM loop round 2 — objectui#10719: retire the eight Phase 3.5 validation types (`AdvancedValidationSchema` and seven siblings) from `@object-ui/types`, on objectui#7659's inherited ruling
Session: `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-10719-retire-phase35-validation-types`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-10719`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#1`
File surface: `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` (the 「Phase 3.5 … Complete Validation Engine」 banner and the eight declarations), `packages/types/src/index.ts` (the root export of the eight), dated in-body notes on the pending changesets `9909-machine-locale-sweep.md`, `7659-retire-validation-engine.md`, `6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-2.md` and `7357-retire-field-metadata-depends-on.md`, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` (the near-spelling list), one barrel-absence pin, and one `.changeset/10719-…md` (`minor`, BREAKING banner). ⛔ Not `FieldValidationRules`, `FieldValidationFunction`, `ObjectValidationRule` or `DesignerValidationRule`. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12534` on objectstack `16c5a33`; `--tier` refuses objectui paths; a ruling-implementation card)
Clause-②: yes
Thread-read: 5851687727
Ruling-ref: objectui#7659 comment 5548579814 (decision batch #40 item 4, maintainer 「同意」 to option A), inherited per triage `5851687727`
Serial constraints cleared: re-measured on objectui `origin/main` `01700dcd7`. Of the open PRs, none touches `data-protocol.ts`, `types/src/index.ts`, `plugin-form.mdx` or the four pending changesets. PR objectui#10744 (this seat, in the merge queue) touches `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` only, and this card does not. No live `pm:dispatched` claim names these paths. objectui#7469 (this round, this seat) also edits `packages/types/src/index.ts`, but at the `App*` exports, which is a different region: ordinary concurrency, and the second to land merges `main`.

**The patch round.** The original dev is not reachable: this seat's container restarted after its report.
